title: "The Utah Pictures" comic page: Air Force cancels press showing; Keyhoe telegram (p. 21)
description: Second comic-book page continuing the Utah film story, with panels of Air Force officers cancelling a planned "press showing and public statement concerning the Utah pictures" and Major Donald E. Keyhoe at his desk. Other panels quote a Henry Holt and Company press release of Sept. 28, 1953 about Keyhoe's book "Flying Saucers from Outer Space," and his telegram challenging the Air Force. A closing column asks questions such as "Where is the original?"
